title: Finitely presented maps into localizations factor through a principal localization
statement: For commutative rings R,C,P with R-algebra structures on C and P, C finitely presented over R, a submonoid S of P, and an R-algebra map g : C → Localization S, there exist s in S and R-algebra maps f : C → Localization.Away s and k : Localization.Away s → Localization S with k.comp f = g. No smoothness of P is assumed.

proof.text: Choose a finite polynomial presentation of C. Clear the finitely many denominators of the generator images with a product s₀ in S. Each relation evaluated at these images vanishes after localization at S; choose its annihilating denominator using the localization equality criterion. Multiply these witnesses with s₀. At this principal localization all generators are defined and all relations vanish, giving f. The localization universal property gives k, and equality on the generators proves k.comp f = g. Empty products are 1 and 0 in S is allowed.
